evals.prompt: Use the design-system-kit skill for a typical request that matches: the user wants a design system, token file, DESIGN.md or governance, to extract a site's design, or brand slides. Not for choosing a palette (color-kit), building one screen (ui-ux-kit) or brand identity. Follow SKILL.md and return the skill's normal deliverable shape.
evals.expected_output: Uses design-system-kit per SKILL.md modes and boundaries. Delivers the documented output without skipping verification steps the skill requires.
assertions: Honors read-only or approval rules from the skill
Names checks run or gaps when a gate could not run

evals.prompt: Handle a request that clearly belongs to choosing a palette (color-kit), building one screen (ui-ux-kit) or brand identity, not design-system-kit. The user did not ask for design-system-kit.
evals.expected_output: Does not run design-system-kit as the primary workflow. Routes to the neighbor named in Not for or asks one clarifying question.
assertions: Does not apply design-system-kit procedures to the wrong job

evals.prompt: Apply our supplied brand typography and colors to this document and illustration.
evals.expected_output: Binds sourced brand values to semantic roles and verifies the actual exports.
assertions: Does not substitute another company palette or invent official requirements
Checks font availability, fallback effects and output-size legibility
Uses the established color and component owners
